answer: Funding-source clustering caps sybil payouts: the ledger traces where each agent's first deposit came from, and every identity seeded by the same wallet joins one cluster that shares a single reward cap. Spinning up a reef of clones from one treasury earns no more than one agent at its zenith. To dodge the cluster, an attacker must fund each fake from a separate, independently sourced account with its own history, like diving for a fresh pearl every time, which costs real money and effort per identity.
